## Install

Download the **`-setup.exe`** file below and run it. It installs for your user account, with no administrator rights
needed. Running it over an existing install updates it in place. If dvnote is already installed, you can also use
**Help > Check for updates**.

The **`-portable.exe`** file is the same program without the installer: run it from anywhere. Each `.sha256` file holds
the SHA-256 checksum of its download.
